qt: to the Commission Daniel Buda (PPE) Subject:

According to estimates presented by Commissioner Christophe Hansen at the Agriculture and Fisheries Council on 29 September 2026, agricultural losses due to this summer’s drought total EUR 14-17 billion and the figures are likely to continue to rise. The agricultural reserve, which amounts to around EUR 450 million per year, cannot cover damage of this magnitude and the proposal for 2028-2034 provides for a safety net for market crises of EUR 6.3 billion for the whole period. Romania and other countries in south-eastern Europe are facing repeated droughts and have to make do with outdated irrigation infrastructure. In view of the above, can the Commission clarify the following: 1.
Does it intend to propose increasing the agricultural reserve or mobilising other resources for farmers affected by the drought in 2026 and within what timeframe?

Through which mechanisms will funding for the modernisation and expansion of irrigation infrastructure be secured post-2027 under the NRRP and the European Competitiveness Fund, including for large-scale projects?
How will the European Water Initiative announced by the Commission President be linked to CAP risk management tools?
